title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Real-ESRGAN Upscale
description: Instruction-driven image editing with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Q4_K_M GGUF) and the Lightning 4-step LoRA, followed by optional Real-ESRGAN x4plus upscaling. Runs on a 48 GB GPU (24 GB works with upscale<=2 and edit_mp<=0.8). Accepts a base64 image plus an edit prompt and an optional style reference image.

input.name: Base model
input.description: Hugging Face repo id supplying the text encoder, VAE and configs.

input.name: Quantization
input.description: gguf = Q4_K_M transformer (24 GB GPUs). bnb4 = NF4 instead. off = bf16, needs 80 GB.

input.name: GGUF quant file
input.description: Only the baked-in file loads without a download. Larger quants need a bigger GPU.

input.name: NF4 text encoder
input.description: Quantize Qwen2.5-VL from 16 GB to ~5.5 GB. Required on 24 GB GPUs.

input.name: Use Lightning LoRA
input.description: Few-step Lightning LoRA: much faster at 4-8 steps. Disable for full 40-step sampling.

input.name: Default inference steps
input.description: Used when a request omits "steps". 4-8 with Lightning, ~40 without.

input.name: CPU offload
input.description: Last resort if the GPU still OOMs. Much slower and needs plenty of host RAM.
